name: SaaSCity
tagline: Audit launch readiness, query 1,600+ startup directories by DR, and verify live backlinks
description: Keyless remote Streamable HTTP MCP server for SaaSCity (https://saascity.io). Run a 16-point static HTML pre-launch readiness audit, filter 1,600+ startup and AI directories by live Ahrefs Domain Rating (DR), link type, and pricing, check whether live directory pages render a followed backlink, run SaaS metric calculators (ARR, churn, NRR, Rule of 40), and search live SaaSCity launches. No API key or account required for read-only tools.
